subject: R crashes instantly on calling 'microclimate' function

messages.author: 9bc1262d7a885e83
messages.subject: R crashes instantly on calling 'microclimate' function
parts:
Hi All, 

I receive the following error when trying to reproduce the exact code provided in Appendix 3 of the NicheMapR 2016 Ecography manuscript describing NicheMapR. I guess it is a problem when making a call to fortran? It kills 'R' instantly. 


 *** caught segfault ***
address 0x30, cause 'memory not mapped'


Traceback:
 1: is.data.frame(x)
 2: `colnames<-`(`*tmp*`, value = c("JULDAY", "TIME", "D0cm", "D2.5cm", "D5cm", "D10cm", "D15cm", "D20cm", "D30cm", "D50cm", "D100cm"))
 3: microclimate(micro)



 
Perhaps there is something wrong with the version of R/OS X? 

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.4.0 (2017-04-21)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin15.6.0 (64-bit)
Running under: OS X El Capitan 10.11.6


Matrix products: default
BLAS: /System/Library/Frameworks/Accelerate.framework/Versions/A/Frameworks/vecLib.framework/Versions/A/libBLAS.dylib
LAPACK: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.4/Resources/lib/libRlapack.dylib


locale:
[1] en_GB.UTF-8/en_GB.UTF-8/en_GB.UTF-8/C/en_GB.UTF-8/en_GB.UTF-8


attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    


loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] compiler_3.4.0 tools_3.4.0



Any help how to solve this bug would be much appreciated, I have version 6.1 of gfortran installed.

Cheers,
Conor

p.s. here is the exact script

parts:
Dear Conor Waldock,

I have never come across that error... However, I have seen in several forums that the same error (segfault error) can happen in ggplot2 and other packages. Thus, I am not sure that that problem comes from Fortran... In some forums advice uninstalling and re-installing all R-packages. It is quite easy using this code:

ip <- installed.packages()
pkgs.to.remove <- ip[!(ip[,"Priority"] %in% c("base", "recommended")), 1]
sapply(pkgs.to.remove, remove.packages)

Here you have the link to one of the forums where people adviced uninstalling/reinstalling:

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/25672974/caught-segfault-error-in-r

Hope it helps! Cheers, 
Urtzi

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: R crashes instantly on calling 'microclimate' function
parts:
Hi Dave,

Looks like I may have missed that earlier question back in 2017 - it may have been due to a change in the number of parameter inputs which made that code Conor was using fail as Fortran expects you to pass all the inputs and the one from the paper would have become outdated.

Your problem, however, appears to be related to the GADS program (the rungads call). It appears not to have compiled properly. Did you install it via install_github? First try running

micro <- micro_global(loc=c(142,-35), run.gads = 0)

That will switch off the gads program.

Then, if that seems to fix it, and you didn't install via install_github, try that (as explained at https://mrke.github.io/getting_started/).

All the best,
Mike
